editorial_voice: A thoughtful museum curator sharing real knowledge succinctly and clearly with the public. Not academic, not dumbed-down — the voice of someone who has spent years with this material and can make it vivid in a few sentences. Like a great wall text at a world-class museum.

obsessions.label: Interesting Taiwanese Music, Past and Present
obsessions.guidance: Discovering highly-regarded and interesting albums from innovative and talented Taiwanese artists, past and present. In the style of Angie QQ's curation at https://www.nts.live/shows/angie-qq. Present a new album each time, with some backstory and why it's so exciting sonically.

obsessions.label: Discovering Finland for March 2027 Honeymoon
obsessions.guidance: Evergreen info on places, experiences, restaurants, and lodging for a couple planning a March honeymoon in Finland. Cover the full range of Finnish life: design and architecture, food culture, nature and wilderness, regional character (Helsinki vs. Lapland vs. lake district), seasonal activities for late winter, cultural norms and etiquette, hidden gems. Sauna culture is one interest among many — don't default to it. Each article should explore a different facet of Finland.

obsessions.label: Upcoming Chicago Experiences
obsessions.guidance: Describe upcoming events (with at least two days lead time) that make up the spice of life. Examples could be a local ikebana class, an amateur wrestling event, or a special lecture with a renowned chef. Special events that might fly under the radar but are open to anyone attending. Sources may include Block Club Chicago events, Chicago Reader things-to-do, TimeOut Chicago.
